title: 4 Objects That Make a Room Read as Old Money
description: A room reads as old money when it is accumulated, not decorated. Four lasting objects: Waterford Lismore crystal, a pure cashmere throw, a LAFCO hand-blown glass candle and marble-and-brass bookends.
intro: A room that reads as old money is rarely decorated. It is accumulated: a few good objects that arrived at different times and were never replaced.
Each object below is useful before it is decorative, and heavy enough in the hand to feel like it will last. Start with one.

picks.name: Waterford Lismore Double Old Fashioned, Set of 2
picks.kicker: Weight you can feel from across the table
picks.alt: Pair of Waterford Lismore cut crystal double old fashioned glasses
paras: A pair of Lismore glasses on a sideboard does more for a room than any new piece of furniture. The deep diamond and wedge cuts throw light across the table every evening.

The fact your guests will not know: the Lismore pattern was created in 1952 by designer Miroslav Havel as a tribute to Ireland's 800-year-old Lismore Castle — and Waterford has kept it unchanged ever since.
picks.verdict: a bar cart, a sideboard, or a whisky poured at the end of the week.

picks.name: State Cashmere Fringe Throw, Camel
picks.kicker: The softest thing in the room
picks.alt: State Cashmere 100% cashmere throw with fringe, camel, 60 by 50 inches, folded
paras: Folded over the arm of a sofa, a camel cashmere throw makes the room look finished. At 60 by 50 inches it is large enough to actually use on a cold evening.
Why it feels different: it is 100% Grade A cashmere from Inner Mongolia — warmth without weight, from goats that grow their finest undercoat to survive harsh winters.
picks.verdict: a sofa, a reading chair, or the foot of a bed.

picks.name: LAFCO New York Chamomile Lavender Candle
picks.kicker: A scent for the room, a vessel for life
picks.alt: LAFCO New York Signature candle, Chamomile Lavender, 15.5 oz in hand-blown glass
paras: Chamomile, lavender and sage make this the calmest scent in LAFCO's range — the one for a bedroom or a reading corner. The 15.5 oz candle burns for about 90 hours.
The detail that makes it worth owning: each vessel is hand-blown glass, and the candle is made in the USA. When the wax is gone, the glass stays on the shelf for pens, brushes or flowers.
picks.verdict: a bedroom, a guest room, or anyone who says they do not like scented candles.

picks.name: Cork & Mill Marble & Brass Bookends, Set of 2
picks.kicker: The cheapest way to make a shelf look considered
picks.alt: Cork & Mill grey and white marble bookends with gold brass inlay, set of two
paras: Bookends are what stop a shelf of books from looking like storage. Solid grey-and-white marble with a brass inlay reads as permanent — cold, heavy and without a trend attached.
Why no two sets are alike: they are cut from natural marble, so the veining on your pair is yours alone. Together they weigh about nine pounds, with a non-skid base that holds heavy books in place.
picks.verdict: a bookshelf, a desk, or a first home with a first real library.

closing: Buy one object a season, not a room in an afternoon. A matched set announces the day it was bought; a room built slowly never looks dated.
